top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements-Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.401(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required telephone numbers posted.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.
